patterns.name: 卡片揭角 (Card Corner Peel)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 做一张可揭角的卡片，右下角按住后随拖动卷起，用折线裁切正面并露出背面，折片带柔和明暗。松手沿原路回落，短距离拖动只露一角，整张卡片保持稳定。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Drag the card's lower-right corner to peel a clipped front layer, reveal the back, then spring back along the inverse path unless committed.
patterns.state_machine: idle -> press -> drag -> partial_peel -> release -> spring_settle
patterns.web_implementation: Motion drag progress with CSS clip-path polygon and @nocoo/basalt tokens.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with Canvas/path clipping, StrataMotion spring, and Reduce Motion crossfade.
patterns.token_guardrails: CLS = 0; tabular-nums where values appear; >=4.5:1 contrast; 44x44pt hit target; Reduce Motion fallback.

patterns.name: 滑动确认 (Slide-to-Confirm)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 做一个滑动确认按钮，圆钮与轨道填充跟随同一拖动进度。未到终点松手，阻尼回到起点且不执行；到终点松手才确认，箭头变成对勾，文字变为已完成。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Keep thumb and track fill on one normalized drag progress; cancel below the endpoint with damped return, commit only at endpoint, then swap arrow to checkmark and copy.
patterns.web_implementation: Motion drag controls thumb and track; CSS/SVG icon morph; Basalt semantic success tokens.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with StrataMotion spring, contentTransition(.symbolEffect), SensoryFeedback, and numericText.
patterns.token_guardrails: No accidental commit; 44x44pt target; explicit threshold; >=4.5:1 contrast; Reduce Motion opacity/state fallback.

patterns.name: 拉绳开关 (Pull-Cord Light Switch)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 做一个拉绳灯光开关，绳头跟随竖向拖动，超过触发距离时切换灯光与玻璃暖光，每次拉动切换一次。松手收回绳子，摆幅逐渐衰减，再拉一次可以关闭。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Track vertical cord drag; cross the trigger distance once to toggle light and warm glass glow, then return with damped swing and allow the next pull to turn it off.
patterns.state_machine: off_idle -> pull -> threshold -> on_commit -> return_swing -> on_idle -> pull -> off_commit -> settle
patterns.web_implementation: Motion drag transform with Anime.js damped return and tokenized warm-glow CSS.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture plus KeyframeAnimator/StrataMotion, ShaderLibrary glow, and SensoryFeedback.
patterns.token_guardrails: One toggle per pull; bounded drag; no glare-only status; 44x44pt target; Reduce Motion removes swing.

patterns.name: 滑动工具栏 (Magnification Scrubbing Toolbar)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 做一条可滑选的工具栏，当前图标随手指靠近连续放大，相邻图标平滑让位，位置由实时宽度累加计算。显示当前名称，松手提交选择，画布同步切换工具效果。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Scrub across a toolbar whose focused icon magnifies continuously and neighbors make room from live accumulated widths; show the name and commit the selected tool on release.
patterns.state_machine: idle -> hover/drag -> focus_magnify -> neighbor_reflow -> release -> commit -> settle
patterns.web_implementation: Motion layout animation with measured widths, CSS transform scale, and tokenized focus ring.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with matchedGeometryEffect, measured layout, and StrataMotion spring.
patterns.token_guardrails: Live width accumulation, no overlap, single-line label, 44x44pt targets, Reduce Motion uses discrete focus.

patterns.name: 消息气泡反馈 (Long-Press Bubble Reaction)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 长按消息后拾起当前气泡，周围消息降低亮度，三枚表情错峰展开。选中并松手后，同一表情沿弧线缩到气泡角标，菜单收回。徽标随气泡归位，再点可取消。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Long-press and lift the message bubble, dim neighbors, stagger three reactions, then arc the selected reaction into the bubble badge on release; tap again cancels.
patterns.state_machine: idle -> long_press -> lifted_dimmed -> reaction_menu -> select -> arc_commit/cancel -> settle
patterns.web_implementation: Motion shared layout with Anime.js stagger and SVG arc path; Basalt reaction tokens.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI long press, matchedGeometryEffect, KeyframeAnimator arc, and SensoryFeedback.
patterns.token_guardrails: Preserve message context; 44x44pt reactions; tabular-nums for counts; Reduce Motion uses fade/scale.

patterns.name: 文件拖入文件夹 (Spring-Loaded Folder Drop)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 拖动文件靠近文件夹时，夹口张开并显示落点；悬停阶段保持原数量；松手命中后文件缩进前后盖之间，数量加一，再合上夹口；未命中则回到原位置。
patterns.canonical_prompt: When a dragged file nears a folder, open the folder and show the drop target without changing count; on hit, tuck the file between covers, increment count, and close, otherwise return.
patterns.state_machine: idle -> drag -> near_target -> folder_open -> hover -> commit/cancel -> settle
patterns.web_implementation: Motion pointer drag with Anime.js folder lid choreography, hit testing, and numeric transition.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture/drop delegate, matchedGeometryEffect tuck, numericText count, and SensoryFeedback.
patterns.token_guardrails: Visible target and hit parity; count changes only on commit; 44x44pt targets; Reduce Motion crossfade.

patterns.name: 图表联动筛选 (Chart Cross-Filtering)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 点图表里的分类，下方列表和统计数字跟着变，再点一下全部恢复。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Click a chart category/segment to highlight it and cross-filter the list and summary metrics below; click the same category again to reset to all items.
patterns.web_implementation: Derive list and KPIs from a shared activeCategory state; highlight active Recharts/Basalt segment, dim unselected segments, and toggle off on repeat click.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI Charts selection binding filtering the shared query state with .contentTransition(.numericText()) on summary readouts and tap-to-deselect.
patterns.token_guardrails: tabular-nums / monospacedDigit for changing metrics; preserve active search keyword and sort order; >=4.5:1 active/inactive contrast.

patterns.name: 组合筛选与排序 (Combined Filter & Orthogonal Sort)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 选好类别搜关键词，还能按数量升降序排，而且排序不会清空之前的筛选条件。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Compose category filter, keyword search, and ascending/descending sort orthogonally; toggling sort order reorders the filtered subset without clearing active filters.
patterns.web_implementation: Pure derived selector: filter(items, category, keyword) then sort(field, dir); keep filter and sort controls in independent state slices.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUIsearchable + category filter tokens + Menu/Picker sort descriptor operating on the filtered collection without resetting filter state.
patterns.token_guardrails: Sorting never clears filter/search state; provide clear active indicators and reset options.

patterns.name: 列表联动详情 (In-Place Master-Detail Linkage)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 点左侧记录，右侧详情直接更新，不用跳页面，列表顺序也不变。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Select a record in the master list to update the detail pane in-place without page navigation, preserving the master list's sort order, filters, and scroll position.
patterns.web_implementation: Two-column master-detail layout with selectedId state; render detail panel in-place and keep master list key/scroll stable.
patterns.mobile_implementation: NavigationSplitView on iPad/macOS or in-place detail card/sheet on compact screens, preserving list scroll and ordering.
patterns.token_guardrails: CLS = 0 on selection; master list order and scroll offset remain unchanged; clear selected row state.

patterns.name: 无结果与局部恢复 (Scoped Empty State & Context-Preserving Recovery)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 搜不到时显示空状态，清空关键词后数据恢复，其他筛选条件还得保留。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Show a contextual empty state when keyword search yields zero matches; clearing the keyword restores matching data while keeping other active filters intact.
patterns.web_implementation: Empty state names the active query/filter and offers a 'Clear keyword' action that resets only searchQuery while preserving category and sort state.
patterns.mobile_implementation: ContentUnavailableView.search(text:) or custom Strata empty state whose reset action clears search text without wiping selected category pills.
patterns.token_guardrails: Empty state explains why and provides a 1-click partial recovery CTA; non-keyword filters remain preserved.

patterns.name: 状态联动汇总 (Live Status-to-Summary Aggregation)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 卡片状态一变，下方的分类数量和颜色也得跟着同步更新。
patterns.canonical_prompt: When an item's status changes, synchronously recompute summary category counts, ratios, and semantic status colors from the same single source of truth.
patterns.web_implementation: Derive summary badges, counts, and semantic color tokens directly from the items array rather than separate static counters.
patterns.mobile_implementation: Computed properties on @Observable / SwiftData model collections driving summary badges and semantic tokens with .numericText() transition.
patterns.token_guardrails: Single source of truth for item status and summary counters; semantic tokens calibrated for both Light and Dark mode.
